models.label: GPT-6 Astra

json_mode.note: Structured Outputs listed as supported; Metis sends response_format json_object (JSON mode), which the Chat Completions reference calls the older method. Not separately confirmed for this model.

long_context_threshold.note: Prompts with more than 272K input tokens are priced at 2x input and cache rates and 1.5x output for the full request.

request.note: When reasoning effort is not none, OpenAI says to remove temperature and top_p. max_completion_tokens bounds visible and reasoning tokens (Chat Completions reference). Astra supports effort low, medium, high, xhigh and max.

free_tier.note: OpenAI rate limits depend on the account's usage tier; see the model page.

capability.note: OpenAI describes it as its most capable model for the most demanding work: complex reasoning, coding, research and documents.

notes: The model page lists a 922,000-token maximum input within the 1,050,000-token context; Metis's size guard uses the larger figure.
Reasoning tokens are billed as output tokens.
Cache writes are billed at 1.25x the input rate; Chat Completions usage does not separate them, so Metis prices them as ordinary input.
